name: Chicago Alternative Comics Expo
blurb: Chicago's weekend-long festival for independent and alternative comics, with small-press exhibitors, panels, an art auction and the Cupcake Award.
notes: CAKE 2026 ran May 2-3, 2026 at the Irish American Heritage Center (per the site's own 'Featured 2026 Cupcake Award Winners' and other May/April 2026 news posts) - before this research window starts (2026-10-05). The official site has not posted 2027 dates yet; a web search only turned up an unconfirmed third-party guess of 'likely May 2027'. No guests field is set since there is no edition in the window to attach it to; CAKE does list 'Special Guests' each year on a per-edition page (e.g. /special26) when dates are announced.
